name: initialPanelSource
label: Initial Panel Source
description: DotWalk V2 prop. Initial panel source (usually a table name)

name: panelDefinitions
label: Panel Definitions
description: DotWalk V2 prop. Array of panel definitions

name: metadata
label: Field Metadata
description: The map of metadata that will be used to display data and navigate through fields and their descendants

name: leafPathSource
label: Leaf Path Source
description: The key used to get field data for the last panel

name: error
label: Error
description: An error message to be displayed by the component

name: contentType
label: Content Type
description: Enum to describe what type of content will be shown for dot walk, specifically for variables and extended fields

name: dotWalkConfig
label: Dot Walk Config
description: Configs for determining if extra fields should be shown on the dot walk panel under an other section

name: customSearchTerm
label: Custom Search Term
description: Allow an external search term to be passed in

name: showSearch
label: Show Search
description: If false, the search bar will be hidden. Default to true
